text:
The detective leaned in, his voice low and steady, cutting through the heavy silence of the interrogation room. "Let’s go back to that night. Where exactly were you when the crime happened?"

The suspect shifted uncomfortably in the chair, his eyes darting away before snapping back to the detective’s face. He swallowed hard, his voice trembling slightly. "I was home. All night. I swear on my life, I didn’t move from my couch."

The detective didn’t blink, studying the man’s micro-expressions, searching for the crack in the story. He needed the truth, no matter how buried it was.

Name the shape with three sides.
